project_id.description: Stable project identifier.

name: project_add
description: Register a project root under a stable project ID.

project_id.description: Stable project identifier.

root.description: Absolute or relative path to an existing project directory.

name: project_list
description: List registered projects and their canonical roots.

name: project_lsp_capabilities
description: Negotiated capabilities for a project's active language servers. Optionally filter by language ID.

language_id.description: Optional language-server identity to filter by.

project_id.description: Registered project whose capabilities should be returned.

ProjectServerCapability.description: Negotiated capability data for one actor group in a logical project.

group_id.description: Actor-group ordinal within the logical project snapshot.

language_id.description: Language ID configured for the server.

name: project_refresh
description: Refresh the status of a registered project.

project_id.description: Stable project identifier.

name: project_remove
description: Permanently forget a registered project and stop its actor. Do not use for session cleanup or activation recovery.

project_id.description: Stable project identifier.

name: project_restart_lsp
description: Restart the language servers for a registered project.

project_id.description: Stable project identifier.

name: project_status
description: Return lifecycle status and the last failure for a project.

project_id.description: Stable project identifier.

name: range_format_preview
description: Preview capability-gated LSP range formatting as a session-owned edit plan. Unsupported servers return supported=false without creating a plan. Apply changed previews with workspace_edit_apply.

end_character.description: One-based end character in UTF-16 code units.

project_id.description: Registered project that owns the file.

start_character.description: One-based start character in UTF-16 code units.

name: rename_apply
description: Apply a rename plan returned by rename_preview. Plans are single-use and revalidated before any file is replaced.

plan_id.description: Opaque plan identifier returned by the preview flow.

project_id.description: Stable project identifier that owns the plan.

name: rename_preview
description: Preview an LSP rename as a session-owned workspace edit plan. Apply the returned plan from this MCP session with workspace_edit_apply.

project_id.description: Registered project that owns the file.

name: rename_symbol
description: Rename symbol across workspace. Returns text edits for all files where symbol is used.

Position2D.description: Position in a document (1-based for MCP).

Range.description: Range in a document (1-based for MCP).

name: server_status
description: Return daemon version, uptime, and non-blocking project status.

name: structural_replace_preview
description: Validate, search, or preview structural replacements without changing files. dialect is required and must be rust_analyzer_ssr (the complete rust-analyzer rule belongs in query) or ast_grep (language_id required; replacement optional for search-only). MCPLS never translates syntax or silently switches engines. A matching replacement returns a session-owned plan for workspace_edit_apply.

file_path.description: Absolute context file used for project containment and rust-analyzer selection.

language_id.description: Explicit ast-grep language ID. Required only for the `ast_grep` dialect.

parse_only.description: Validate dialect syntax without searching or constructing a plan.

position_encoding.description: Position encoding for ast-grep ranges and workspace-edit planning.

project_id.description: Registered project that owns the context file and resulting plan.

query.description: Exact query in the selected dialect; MCPLS never translates it.

replacement.description: ast-grep replacement template. Omit for search-only requests.

name: subscription_list
description: List resource URIs subscribed by this MCP session.

name: workspace_edit_apply
description: Apply one workspace edit plan previewed by this MCP session, by project ID and opaque plan ID. Plans are single-use and are revalidated before any file is replaced.

plan_id.description: Opaque plan identifier returned by the preview flow.

project_id.description: Stable project identifier that owns the plan.

name: workspace_edit_preview
description: Preview a project-scoped LSP WorkspaceEdit. The returned plan is owned by this MCP session and includes a plan ID, unified diff, affected files, preconditions, conflicts, unsupported operations, and explicit safety state.

position_encoding.description: Negotiated LSP position encoding, defaulting to UTF-8 for this API.

project_id.description: Stable project identifier that owns the workspace roots and plan.

workspace_edit.description: LSP `WorkspaceEdit` object returned by a language server.

name: workspace_symbol_search
description: Search project symbols with exact-first ranking, bounded source frames, and reusable symbol handles. Match mode defaults to fuzzy; external/dependency symbols require scope=all.

oneOf.description: Return only exact case-sensitive or case-insensitive names.
Return exact and prefix matches.
Return exact, prefix, and fuzzy matches, ranked in that order.
Only symbols under a registered project root.
Include dependency and other external symbols returned by the language server.

kind_filter.description: Optional filter by symbol kind (function, class, variable, etc.).

match_mode.description: Name matching behavior; defaults to exact-first fuzzy search.

project_id.description: Registered project identifier whose workspace should be searched.

query.description: Search query for symbol names (supports partial matching).

scope.description: Source scope; dependencies and external symbols require explicit `all`.

path.description: Human-readable filesystem path for file-backed targets.

source.description: Bounded source text for this location, or a stable reason it is unavailable.

symbol_handle.description: Snapshot-bound target for coordinate-free semantic follow-ups.

Position2D.description: Position in a document (1-based for MCP).

Range.description: Range in a document (1-based for MCP).

SourceContext.description: Source context attached to a semantic result location.

oneOf.description: The source was safely resolved.
The source could not be safely resolved.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the exact content used for this frame.

document_version.description: Open-document version, when the frame came from actor-owned state.

highlighted_range.description: Range highlighted by consumers; currently identical to `range`.

total_bytes.description: Number of source bytes available in the selected line window.

total_lines.description: Number of source lines in the resolved snapshot.

truncated.description: Whether a line or byte budget shortened the frame.

SourceUnavailableReason.description: Stable reasons source text is unavailable.

oneOf.description: The LSP returned a URI other than `file:`.
The path is outside registered workspace and approved source roots.
The tracked or on-disk source no longer exists.
The source could not be read as UTF-8 text.
The response-wide source budget was exhausted.

SymbolHandle.description: Opaque project-actor-owned reference to a symbol at one source snapshot.

kind.description: Kind of symbol.

match_class.description: How the name matched the query.

origin.description: Whether the symbol belongs to the registered project or external source.

project_relative_path.description: Path relative to the registered project root, when project-local.

score.description: Stable score derived from `match_class`; larger is better.

WorkspaceSymbolMatch.description: How a workspace-symbol name matched the query.

oneOf.description: Exact case-sensitive name.
Exact name ignoring case.
Name starts with the query, ignoring case.
Query characters occur in order in the name.

WorkspaceSymbolOrigin.description: Workspace-symbol ownership relative to the registered project.

oneOf.description: Symbol source is under a registered project root.
Symbol source is outside every registered project root.

returned.description: Number of symbols in this response.

total.description: Number of matching symbols before the item budget.

truncated.description: Whether the item budget omitted matching symbols.
